ambient_events: Wind whistles through the split in the broken kiln and dies away inside it.
Old scorch-marks and newer bootprints share the floor of the kiln; you are not the first to almost rest here.
description: The cracked shell of a brick kiln, split down one side so it gapes like a broken jaw. Inside, out of the wind, is one of the few places in the wastes a person can almost rest. Almost.
name: Broken Kiln
